test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article for ₹19.5, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 30%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = ₹19.5

Profit % = 10%

Desired Profit % = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit % / 100)

New Selling Price (New SP) = CP × (1 + Desired Profit % / 100)

Increase in Selling Price = New SP - SP

**Calculation:**

CP = SP / (1 + Profit % / 100)

⇒ CP = 19.5 / (1 + 10 / 100)

⇒ CP = 19.5 / 1.1

⇒ CP = ₹17.73 (rounded to two decimal places)

New SP = CP × (1 + Desired Profit % / 100)

⇒ New SP = 17.73 × (1 + 30 / 100)

⇒ New SP = 17.73 × 1.3

⇒ New SP = ₹23.05 (rounded to two decimal places)

Increase in Selling Price = New SP - SP

⇒ Increase = 23.05 - 19.5

⇒ Increase = ₹3.55

**The dealer should increase the selling price by ₹3.55 to make a profit of 30%.**
